Closet remains open.

Closet door is fully closed.

Microwave door has swung open.
Microwave door remains fully open.
Hand pushes the microwave door closed.

Hand begins pulling the oven handle downward.
Oven door is open and the lit interior is visible.
Oven remains open.
Hand raises the oven door toward closed.
Oven door is closed.

Dishwasher door is open with racks visible.
Dishwasher remains open.
Hand lifts the dishwasher door toward closed.

The left cabinet leaf is projecting outward and the cabinet interior becomes visible.

Cabinet leaves are being pushed toward the frame.

events.object_description: Left leaf of the double-door upper cabinet above the sink (open = on)

evidence.note: Hand initiates opening at the double-door cabinet seam.
The right cabinet leaf is also visibly swung outward.
Both cabinet leaves remain open.
Hand closes the projecting cabinet leaf; the paired leaves close in this short interval.
Both cabinet leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Right leaf of the double-door upper cabinet above the sink (open = on)

evidence.note: Hand pulls the narrow drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is open and its contents are visible.
Drawer remains open.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Narrow kitchen drawer beside the refrigerator (open = on)

evidence.note: Hand pulls the upper refrigerator-door handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and interior light is on.
Upper refrigerator door remains open.
Hand pushes the upper door shut.
Upper refrigerator door is closed.
Hand pulls the lower freezer handle.
Lower freezer door is open, exposing the freezer drawers.
Freezer door remains open as the hand begins closing it.
Lower freezer door is closed.
Laundry-closet door is closed immediately before opening.
Door is open, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry closet remains open.
Hand pulls the laundry-closet door shut.
Laundry-closet door is closed.

notes: Open is treated as the on state for doors and the drawer. The paired upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts, although both transitions occur within very short sampled intervals.
scene_description: A person traverses a compact apartment kitchen and living area, sequentially opening and closing a closet, appliance doors, cabinet leaves, a drawer, refrigerator/freezer doors, and a laundry closet.
